### *Transformation2D, Transformation3D*

Create a transformation 2D or transformation 3D dataset. Use a transformation dataset to scale, rotate, and move a geometry in another dataset. If you use multiple transformations, note that they are performed in that order and that they do not always commute. If you need a transformation in another order, use multiple transformation datasets in succession with only one type of transformation in each dataset.

#### **SYNTAX**

```
model.result().dataset().create(<dtag>,"Transformation2D");
model.result().dataset().create(<dtag>,"Transformation3D");
model.result().dataset(<dtag>).setIndex(...);
model.result().dataset(<dtag>).set(property,<value>);
```

See set(), setIndex(), and Methods Associated to Set, SetIndex, and the Various Get Methods for more information.

#### **DESCRIPTION**

model.result().dataset().create(<dtag>,"Transformation2D") creates a 2D transformation dataset feature named *<dtag>*.

model.result().dataset().create(<dtag>,"Transformation3D") creates a 3D transformation dataset feature named *<dtag>*.

This dataset takes a geometry from another dataset and adds a transformation that can include scaling, rotation, and translation (moving).

The following properties are available for Transformation2D and Transformation3D:

TABLE 7-163: VALID PROPERTIES FOR TRANSFORMATION DATASETS (IF NOT NOTED, PROPERTIES ARE FOR THE STRUCTURED TRANSFORMATION TYPE).

| NAME       | VALUE                                | DEFAULT                     | DESCRIPTION                                                                                                                                                             |
|------------|--------------------------------------|-----------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| ax2        | double array                         | {0,0}                       | Theta and phi angles for the rotation, if type<br>is set to linear and axistype is set to<br>spherical for a Rotation3D dataset, and if<br>enablerot is true.           |
| ax3        | double array                         | {0, 0, 0}                   | Axis coordinates (x, y, and z) for the rotation,<br>if type is set to linear and axistype is set<br>to cartesian for a Rotation3D dataset, and if<br>enablerot is true. |
| axistype   | x   y   z   cartesian<br>  spherical | z                           | The axis type for a rotation, if type is set to<br>linear for a Rotation3D dataset, if<br>enablerot is true.                                                            |
| data       | none   dataset name                  | First compatible<br>dataset | The dataset this feature refers to                                                                                                                                      |
| enablemove | Boolean                              | false                       | Enable moving (translating) the geometry.                                                                                                                               |
| enablerot  | Boolean                              | false                       | Enable rotating the geometry.                                                                                                                                           |

TABLE 7-163: VALID PROPERTIES FOR TRANSFORMATION DATASETS (IF NOT NOTED, PROPERTIES ARE FOR THE STRUCTURED TRANSFORMATION TYPE).

| NAME        | VALUE                   | DEFAULT                             | DESCRIPTION                                                                                           |
|-------------|-------------------------|-------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| enablescale | Boolean                 | false                               | Enable scaling of the geometry.                                                                       |
| move        | double array            | {0, 0} (2D), {0,<br>0, 0} (3D)      | The move (translation), if transtype is<br>general, if enablemove is true.                            |
| rotangle    | double                  | 0                                   | The angle increment for a rotation, if<br>enablerot is true.                                          |
| rotcenter   | double array            | {0, 0}                              | The rotation center for a Rotation2D dataset.                                                         |
| scale       | Numerical array         | Depends on the<br>feature's tag     | The scaling in the x, y (2D and 3D), and z (3D<br>only) directions, if enablescale is true.           |
| spacevars   | String array            | Depends on the<br>feature's tag     | The name of space variables, which evaluate to<br>the coordinates after the transformation.           |
| translation | double array            | {0, 0} (2D), {0,<br>0, 0} (3D)      | The translation, if transtype is general.                                                             |
| transmatrix | double array            | 2-by-2 or 3-by-3<br>matrix of zeros | The base vectors of a transformation, specified<br>using setIndex syntax, if transtype is<br>general. |
| transtype   | structured  <br>general | structured                          | The transformation type.                                                                              |

### *Transformation*

Transform (scale, move, and rotate) some 2D and 3D plot types.

#### **SYNTAX**

```
model.result(<pgtag>).feature(<ftag>).create(<atag>,"Transformation");
model.result(<pgtag>).feature(<ftag>).feature(<atag>).set(property,<value>);
```

### **DESCRIPTION**

model.result(*<pgtag>*).feature(*<ftag>*).create(*<atag>*,"Transformation") creates a transformation attribute feature with the name *<atag>*, belonging to the feature *<ftag>*.

Transformation attributes can transform the coordinates of a plot feature by specified values for scaling, rotation, and moving. The transformation attribute can be added to arrow plots; contour plots; isosurface plots; particle plots; pellets plots; slice plots; streamline, streamline multislice, and streamline surface plots; surface plots; volume plots; and mesh plots.

|---------------------|--------------|---------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|

| ax2                 | double array | {0,0}   | Theta and phi angles for the rotation, if type is<br>set to linear and axistype is set to<br>spherical for a Rotation3D dataset, and if<br>enablerot is true. |

| axistype    | x   y   z  <br>cartesian  <br>spherical | z                                   | The axis type for a rotation, if type is set to<br>linear for a Rotation3D dataset, if enablerot<br>is true.                                                            |

### *TubeData*

Create a tube data plot.

#### **SYNTAX**

```
model.result(<pgtag>).create(<ftag>,"TubeData");
model.result(<pgtag>).feature(<ftag>).set(property,<value>);
```

#### **DESCRIPTION**

model.result(*<pgtag>*).create(*<ftag>*,"TubeData") creates a tube data plot feature named *<ftag>* belonging to the 2D or 3D plot group *<pgtag>*.

Tube data plots are used to visualize raw point data given as points, elements, and colors as tubes (see the examples below). Tube data plots can be added to 2D and 3D plot groups.

Marker, MaterialAppearance

#### **EXAMPLES**

A method for creating a logarithmic tube spiral in 2D:

```
Code for Use with Java
  String pgTag = model.result().uniquetag("pg");
  ResultFeature pg = model.result().create(pgTag, 2);
  ResultFeature plot = pg.create("tube1", "TubeData");
  int N = 100;
  double[][] p = new double[2][N];
  double[] radius = new double[N];
  for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
   double par = 0.05*i;
   p[0][i] = Math.exp(par)*Math.cos(3*par);
   p[1][i] = Math.exp(par)*Math.sin(3*par);
   radius[i] = 0.3;
  }
  plot.set("pointdata", p).set("radiusdata", radius);
A method for creating a logarithmic tube spiral in 3D:
Code for Use with Java
  String pgTag = model.result().uniquetag("pg");
  ResultFeature pg = model.result().create(pgTag, 3);
  ResultFeature plot = pg.create("tube1", "TubeData");
  int N = 1000;
  double[][] p = new double[3][N];
  double[] radius = new double[N];
  double[] color = new double[N];
  for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
   double par = 0.005*i;
   p[0][i] = Math.exp(par)*Math.cos(10*par);
   p[1][i] = Math.exp(par)*Math.sin(10*par);
   p[2][i] = 0.1*i;
   radius[i] = 0.2*Math.sqrt(i+1);
   color[i] = i;
  }
  plot.set("pointdata", p)
   .set("radiusdata", radius)
   .set("colordata", color)
   .set("coloring", "colortable");
```

### *VisualEffects*

Add or turn off visual effects such as lighting and shadows for some 3D plot types and 2D plot types with a height attribute.

#### **SYNTAX**

```
model.result(<pgtag>).feature(<ftag>).create(<atag>,"VisualEffects");
model.result(<pgtag>).feature(<ftag>).feature(<atag>).set(property,<value>);
```

#### **DESCRIPTION**

model.result(*<pgtag>*).feature(*<ftag>*).create(*<atag>*,"VisualEffects") adds a feature for adding or turning off visual effects named *<atag>* as an attribute to an annotation, arrow, contour, coordinate system, image, isosurface, layered material slice, line, max/min, mesh, multislice, particle tracing, particle tracing with mass, particle trajectories, pellets, Poincaré map, point, point trajectories, principal stress, radiation pattern, ray trajectories, scatter volume, slice, streamline, streamline multislice, streamline surface, surface, surface slit, table annotation, volume, waterfall, or whirl 3D plot named *<ftag>* or to a contour, function, histogram, matrix histogram, table contour, table histogram, line, optical aberration, surface, or table surface 2D plot named *<ftag>* and using a height expression attribute. The visual effects may not be visible for all plot types that support them, but the effects will be visible for all plots that include surfaces.

The following properties are available:

TABLE 7-167: VALID PROPERTIES FOR VISUALEFFECTS.

| NAME           | VALUE         | DEFAULT | DESCRIPTION                                                   |
|----------------|---------------|---------|---------------------------------------------------------------|
| directcasts    | true   false  | true    | Cast shadows for direct shadows, if directmode is manual.     |
| directmode     | auto   manual | auto    | Use automatic or manual settings for direct shadows.          |
| directreceives | true   false  | true    | Receive shadows for direct shadows, if directmode is manual.  |
| lighting       | true   false  | true    | Affected by lighting or not.                                  |
| ssaocasts      | true   false  | true    | Cast shadows for ambient occlusion, if ssaomode is manual.    |
| ssaomode       | auto   manual | auto    | Use automatic or manual settings for ambient occlusion.       |
| ssaoreceives   | true   false  | true    | Receive shadows for ambient occlusion, if ssaomode is manual. |

| outersolnum            | nonnegative integer                                                                   | 1                                                                                                                                 | The index of the outer solutions to use.<br>Applicable only for parametric sweep<br>models.                                                                                                                                                                          |
| prefixintitle          | String                                                                                | Empty                                                                                                                             | Added prefix to contribution to title.                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| radiusexpr             | String                                                                                | Empty                                                                                                                             | The tube radius expression.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| recover                | off   pprint   ppr                                                                    | off                                                                                                                               | The derivative recovery method (off,<br>within domains, or everywhere).                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| refine                 | nonnegative integer                                                                   | 1                                                                                                                                 | The element refinement to use, if<br>resolution is set to manual. Bear in<br>mind that this is the refinement used for<br>the base dataset, so the number of<br>elements in the model can increase<br>radically if the plot uses, for example, a<br>revolve dataset. |

TABLE 7-170: VALID PROPERTIES FOR WHIRL PLOTS.

|-----------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| resolution      | norefine   coarse  <br>normal   fine   finer<br>  extrafine   custom                  | normal                                                                                        | Controls the plot's resolution. A finer<br>setting results in a higher resolution by<br>modifying the internally computed<br>default refinement. Use custom to enter<br>your own refinement in the refine<br>property.                                                                                         |
| ringcolor       | custom   black   blue<br>  cyan   gray   green  <br>magenta   red   white<br>  yellow | blue                                                                                          | The color to use for the rings in the<br>whirl plot.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| smooth          | none   material  <br>internal  <br>everywhere  <br>expression                         | material                                                                                      | Smoothing settings. With material,<br>smoothing is done inside domains with<br>the same material. With internal,<br>smoothing is done inside geometry<br>domains. With expression, the<br>smoothing is based on the expression in<br>smoothexpr.                                                               |
| smoothexpr      | String                                                                                | dom                                                                                           | The expression to use for smoothing<br>when smooth is set to expression.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| solnum          | nonnegative integer                                                                   | Last solution<br>for transient or<br>parametric<br>solution.<br>Otherwise,<br>first solution. | The index of the solution to use.<br>Available when data is not parent and<br>the underlying data has multiple<br>solutions.                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| solutionparams  | manual   parent                                                                       | manual                                                                                        | If data is a local dataset with nontrivial<br>data, specify solutions manually or take<br>them from the parent plot group.                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| suffixintitle   | String                                                                                | Empty                                                                                         | Added suffix to contribution to title.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| t               | double                                                                                | Time<br>corresponding<br>to last selected<br>solnum.                                          | The time to use, for transient problems.<br>Available when data is not parent and<br>the underlying data is transient.                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| threshold       | manual   none                                                                         | none                                                                                          | Use a smoothing threshold.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| thresholdvalue  | double                                                                                | 0.1                                                                                           | Threshold value (0–1), if threshold is<br>set to manual.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| timeinterp      | on   off                                                                              | off                                                                                           | on if t is used to determine time steps;<br>off if solnum is used.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| title           | String                                                                                | The auto-title                                                                                | The title to use when titletype is<br>manual.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| titletype       | auto   custom   label<br>  manual   none                                              | auto                                                                                          | auto, if the title should be computed<br>automatically. custom, if the title should<br>be computed automatically, but<br>customized. label, if the title should be<br>the plot group's label. manual, if the<br>manual title should be used (the title<br>property). none, if no title should be<br>displayed. |

Color, MaterialAppearance, Transparency

## Graphical User Interfaces

In this chapter you find reference information about functionality that is useful if you want to create your own Graphical User Interface (GUI) that calls the COMSOL® API. On Windows®, the Application Builder is the primary COMSOL tool for creating custom applications and user interfaces based on COMSOL Multiphysics models with the possibility to use the COMSOL API and Java® for enhanced and extended functionality. For more information, see the documentation for the Application Builder.

Using the functionality described in this guide, you can create custom GUIs that utilize the modeling and analysis capabilities in COMSOL Multiphysics and create 1D, 2D, and 3D plots directly in your applications.
